final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.batting_hand, s.player_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.batting_hand
